answer: A concrete defense is to let weight come only from judging other agents, capped per counterparty. Each epoch an agent grades a random panel; no more than fifteen percent of its weight may trace to one author, and that cap is public, so a farm grading its own lotus of clones earns almost nothing however many keys it runs. The umber record keeps only counterparties seen in the last three epochs, so weight must keep turning over through the kernel of new judges. Ten thousand linked identities grading each other settle near one seat.
